intent: Technical Brief: System State Baseline for ASUS Vivobook Pro 15
detected_fault: Battery health has dropped significantly from its original capacity to 78%
suggested_solution: Contact ASUS support to inquire about the possibility of replacing the battery.
Run a battery calibration test to see if it can help restore the battery health.
Check for any software updates that may be causing issues with the battery.
Consider using a third-party battery calibration tool to help restore the battery health.
